ShortDescription.Value: Reduce taxi traffic usage in the city for Citizens, Tourists, Commuters.

Publish.LongDescription:
### Taxi Traffic [BETA] Citizens make smarter travel choices by reducing taxi use.
### What it does - ✅ **Residents avoid taxis**, set the range for locals; 0% = vanilla behavior | 100% = maximum avoid taxis - ✅ Features: **Commuters avoid taxis** and **Tourists avoid taxis** [x] toggles let you reduce taxi use for those groups too.
### What to expect - Taxi traffic drops after the city runs for a few minutes. - Existing taxis may still be visible briefly while active trips finish naturally. - Use **Game Defaults** to restore vanilla taxi choices (toggles off and Resident slider at 0%).
### Safety / compatibility - Safe to remove anytime. No Harmony based patching; less likely to break on game patch day. - Tip: to verify usage, check Options menu > mod Status, see if usage is going down after a city runs a little.
### Support and Feedback - Easiest way to support is click the LIKE 👍 button (top right). - For Feedback use Github or Discord links (icons on right side of page). PR's are welcome.
### Credits and Thanks - RiverMochi: mod author - Noel/Noel2 (of MapExt): testing, feedback - Thumbnail: Wikipedia Traffic Congestion, photo by joiseyshowaa from Freehold, NJ - World Class Traffic Jam 2, license CC BY-SA 2.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?curid=63542844
### How it works
- Taxi Traffic (TT) uses the game's own ignore taxis methods instead of shutting down the whole taxi system (easier + safer). - Some taxis may still remain. Active trips are allowed to finish naturally for game stability. Some systems may independently call taxis. - Removing taxi stands prevents taxis from parking there. - Fun Fact: if local taxi supply can't meet demand, the game uses outside connection (OC) taxis to fill local requests. - Recommended: have some local taxi depots if you prefer slider and toggles are at anything but full ON [x]. This prevents more inbound OC taxis. - Alternately, in testing, we discovered making the slider full 100% + Commuter ON + Tourist ON, also prevented OC taxi traffic because there was almost no taxi demand left. - Fun Fact: game update 1.5.7 changed moving-in cims to reach the destination with no taxi trip; it even moves their pet target with teleport: true.
